query: MATCH (m:Meeting) OPTIONAL MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:MADE_AT]->(m), (r)-[:REFERENCES]->(:Tdoc)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(:Release {releaseName:'Rel-18'}) RETURN m.canonicalMeetingNumber AS meetingNumber,m.meetingNumberInt AS meetingNumberInt,count(DISTINCT r) AS resCount ORDER BY meetingNumberInt ASC,meetingNumber ASC
